verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents its own grant workflow: awards can be issued one by one or in bulk, with contracts created, signed and shared, and granting, document and signature workflows can be automated. That covers the core 'issue options to a new hire' step. Nothing in the evidence describes a board approval flow, 409A valuations or a 409A-compliant strike price, or links these into one end-to-end workflow. Missing for 10: board approval flow, 409A valuation/strike price setting, evidence of a single end-to-end issuance workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue options to a new hire with a board approval flow and a 409A-compliant strike price in one end-to-end workflow

citations.quote: Grant share awards one by one, or in bulk, creating, signing and sharing contracts in just a few clicks.
Automate your granting, document and signature workflows in bulk to make expansion easy.
